text_blocks.snippet: If exposed to COVID-19, symptoms can appear anywhere from 2 to 14 days after exposure. The average time for symptoms to develop is around 5-6 days, according to WebMD. In some cases, symptoms may appear as early as 2 days after exposure or as late as 14 days or more, with rare instances potentially extending beyond 14 days. Some individuals may contract COVID-19 and never experience symptoms at all.
